testsGenerated.description: xUnit controller tests for SchedulingController (B1 - P0). Tests cover all 7 HTTP endpoints: ScheduleDataSourceAsync, UnscheduleDataSourceAsync, UpdatePollingIntervalAsync, PauseDataSourcePollingAsync, ResumeDataSourcePollingAsync, TriggerImmediatePollingAsync, GetScheduleStatusAsync, GetAllSchedulesAsync. ISchedulingManager and BusinessMetrics are mocked. Covers success paths, not-found paths, and exception (500) paths.

xUnit controller tests for CategoriesController (B2a - P1). Tests cover GetAll (active/inactive/exception), GetById (found/not-found), Create (valid/invalid-model/null-sortorder), Update (found/not-found), Delete (found/not-found), Reorder (valid/exception), ToggleActive (found/not-found), GetUsageCount (with-datasources/not-found). ICategoryService is mocked.

xUnit controller tests for FileOperationsController (B2b - P1). Tests cover ListFiles (success, null-pattern defaults to *, not-found, bad-request, 500, empty-result), ReadFile (success, empty-path, not-found, bad-request), WriteFile (success, empty-path, empty-content, invalid-base64, not-found, correct-bytes-decoded, 500). IFileOperationsService is mocked.

xUnit controller tests for InvalidRecordController (B4 - P1). Tests cover: GetInvalidRecords (paged/exception), GetInvalidRecord (found/not-found), GetStatistics (success/exception), UpdateStatus (found/not-found), DeleteRecord (found/not-found), BulkDelete (all-success/partial-failure/exception), CorrectRecord (success/failure), ReprocessRecord (success/failure), BulkReprocess (success/exception), BulkIgnore (success/exception), ExportToCsv (success/exception), Health. Both IInvalidRecordService and ICorrectionService are mocked.

xUnit controller tests for MetricController (B5 - P1). Tests cover GetAll (success/exception), GetById (found/not-found), Create (unique-name/duplicate-name/exception), Update (found/not-found), Delete (found/not-found/delete-returns-false), Duplicate (success/exception), GetByDataSource (results/empty), GetGlobal, GetAvailableBusinessMetrics (count/names), GetAvailableSystemMetrics (success/names/no-db). IMetricRepository is mocked. Static DB.Find calls in BuildMetricDtoAsync are acknowledged (DataSourceName=null in unit tests). Sync endpoints fully isolated.
Test project for SchedulingService. References DataProcessing.Scheduling.csproj. xUnit + Moq + FluentAssertions.
Test project for InvalidRecordsService. References InvalidRecordsService.csproj.
Test project for MetricsConfigurationService. References MetricsConfigurationService.csproj.

notes: MetricController.BuildMetricDtoAsync uses MongoDB.Entities DB.Find() static - cannot be unit-mocked. Tests assert HTTP status codes and IsSuccess flags; DataSourceName will be null in unit test context.
BusinessMetrics in SchedulingController is mocked via Mock<BusinessMetrics> - verify the class is not sealed if Moq setup fails.
All test projects target net10.0 to match source projects.

summary: Generated 78 xUnit unit tests across 5 new test projects covering B1 (Scheduling, 15 tests), B2a (Categories, 17 tests), B2b (FileOperations, 15 tests), B4 (InvalidRecords, 21 tests), and B5 (MetricsConfiguration, 20 tests). All tests use Moq for interface mocking and FluentAssertions for readable assertions. Tests based on actual source code signatures read from the codebase - no assumptions about method signatures.
